Name: PARTS_DRAW_PARAM_ST
Description: Draw settings for models: LOD switch distances, texture LOD, draw and shadow distances with fades, shadow and reflection flags, and the motion blur range. Distances are in metres.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 1
Fields.Description: Reserved for package export. Not used.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 2
Fields.Description: Reserved for package export. Not used.

Fields.Name: LOD 0-1 Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance where the model switches from LOD 0 to LOD 1 (the centre of the switch). In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 0-1 Play Distance
Fields.Description: Margin either side of the LOD 0-1 border distance, so the switch does not flicker. In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 1-2 Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance where the model switches from LOD 1 to LOD 2 (the centre of the switch). In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 1-2 Play Distance
Fields.Description: Margin either side of the LOD 1-2 border distance, so the switch does not flicker. In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 2-3 Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance where the model switches from LOD 2 to LOD 3 (the centre of the switch). In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 2-3 Play Distance
Fields.Description: Margin either side of the LOD 2-3 border distance, so the switch does not flicker. In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 3-4 Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance where the model switches from LOD 3 to LOD 4 (the centre of the switch). In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 3-4 Play Distance
Fields.Description: Margin either side of the LOD 3-4 border distance, so the switch does not flicker. In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 4-5 Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance where the model switches from LOD 4 to LOD 5 (the centre of the switch). In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 4-5 Play Distance
Fields.Description: Margin either side of the LOD 4-5 border distance, so the switch does not flicker. In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 5-6 Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance where the model switches from LOD 5 to LOD 6 (the centre of the switch). In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 5-6 Play Distance
Fields.Description: Margin either side of the LOD 5-6 border distance, so the switch does not flicker. In metres.

Fields.Name: Texture Switch - LOD 0-1 Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance where the model switches to its low-resolution textures (the centre of the switch). In metres. 0: texture LOD disabled.

Fields.Name: Texture Switch - LOD 0-1 Play Distance
Fields.Description: Margin either side of the texture LOD border distance. In metres.

Fields.Name: Enable Crossfade
Fields.Description: If ON, LOD levels cross-fade instead of switching instantly.

Fields.Name: No FarClip
Fields.Description: Disables far clipping and always draws at the farthest depth of clip space. Mainly for skydomes.

Fields.Name: Follow Camera on XZ Plane
Fields.Description: The asset follows the camera on the XZ plane.

Fields.Name: Draw in Skydome Phase
Fields.Description: Draws the model in the skydome drawing phase.

Fields.Name: Draw - Max Distance
Fields.Description: Maximum drawing distance. In the open, it will be used for the activation distance

Fields.Name: Draw - Fade Range
Fields.Description: Fade distance from the maximum drawing distance to the actual disappearance

Fields.Name: Shadow Draw - Max Distance
Fields.Description: Maximum shadow drawing distance

Fields.Name: Shadow Draw - Fade Range
Fields.Description: Fade distance from the maximum shadow drawing distance to the actual disappearance

Fields.Name: Motion Blur - Max Distance
Fields.Description: Motion blur is applied to the model only within this distance. In metres.

Fields.Name: Casts Point Light Shadows
Fields.Description: The model casts shadows from point lights.

Fields.Name: Casts Directional Light Shadows
Fields.Description: The model casts shadows from directional (parallel) light.

Fields.Name: Receives Shadows
Fields.Description: The model receives shadows.

Fields.Name: Shadow Only
Fields.Description: The model is drawn only as a shadow.

Fields.Name: Drawn in Reflections
Fields.Description: The model is drawn by the reflection camera, so it appears in reflections.

Fields.Name: Drawn Only in Reflections
Fields.Description: The model is drawn only by the reflection camera.

Fields.Name: Include LOD Map Level
Fields.Description: Highest LOD map level that includes this model.

Fields.Name: LoD Type
Fields.Description: LoD target type and size

Fields.Name: Distant View - Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance where the model switches to its distant view model. In metres.

Fields.Name: Distant View - Play Distance
Fields.Description: Margin either side of the distant view border distance. In metres.

Fields.Name: Open-world - Build Limit Distance
Fields.Description: In open areas, the asset is not built while the camera is closer than this. For distant-view assets. In metres. -1: disabled (default).

Fields.Name: Open-world - Build Limit Play Distance
Fields.Description: Margin either side of the open-world build limit distance. In metres.

Fields.Name: Z Sort Offset for No Far Clip Draw
Fields.Description: Z-sort offset used when far clipping is disabled. When two models are at the same distance from the camera, the one with the smaller offset is drawn in front.

Fields.Name: Shadow Draw Alpha Test Distance
Fields.Description: Alpha testing is used when drawing the model's shadow only within this distance. In metres.

Fields.Name: Shadow Draw LOD Offset
Fields.Description: LOD level offset value when drawing shadows

Fields.Name: Load Balancer - Draw Distance Scale Param ID
Fields.Description: Load balancer drawing distance scale parameter ID
